					}
				}

					value < 1

				owner = {
					has_technology = tech_industrial_storm_protection
				}

					exists = owner
					owner = {
						is_wilderness_empire = no
						NOT = {
							has_origin = origin_storm_chasers
						}
					}
					OR = {
						owner = {
							is_ai = no
						}
						solar_system? = {
							system_has_storm_repelling_tech = no
						}
					}
				}
				num_buildings = {

					value < 1
				}

				}
			}
		}
	}

						is_fallen_empire = yes
						has_technology = tech_fe_affluence_2
						has_country_flag = affluence_emporium_can_build
					}
				}
				NOR = {
					has_modifier = resort_colony
					has_modifier = slave_colony
					has_modifier = penal_colony
				}
			}
			AND = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					fail_text = ancrel.10004.failtext
					owner? = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = {
								which = affluence_emporium_upgrade_count
								value >= 1
							}
							is_fallen_empire = yes
							has_technology = tech_fe_affluence_2
						}
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					fail_text = cosmogenesis_aborted_tt
					NOT = {
						owner? = {
							has_country_flag = cosmogenesis_aborted
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		num_buildings = {
			type = building_affluence_center
			value < 1
		}
		OR = {
			has_active_building = building_affluence_emporium
			AND = {
				AND = {
					AND = {
						owner? = {
							OR = {
								is_fallen_empire = yes
								has_country_flag = affluence_emporium_can_build
								has_technology = tech_fe_affluence_1
							}
							is_hive_empire = no
						}
						NOR = {
							has_modifier = resort_colony
							has_modifier = slave_colony
							has_modifier = penal_colony
						}
					}
					AND = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							fail_text = ancrel.10004.failtext
							owner? = {
								OR = {
									check_variable = {
										which = affluence_emporium_build_count
										value >= 1
									}
									is_fallen_empire = yes
									has_technology = tech_fe_affluence_1
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				num_buildings = {
					type = building_affluence_emporium
					value < 1
				}
				AND = {
					free_building_slots > 0
					rb_le_building_zones_for_building_affluence_emporium = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					fail_text = building_ai_emporium_fail_tt

						NOT = {
							any_owned_planet = {
								has_branch_office = yes
								has_holding = {
									holding = building_ai_emporium
									owner = prevprev.branch_office_owner
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					fail_text = building_ai_emporium_outlawed_robots_tt

						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		}
		free_branch_office_building_slots > 0
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_amphitheater_of_the_mind = {
	AND = {
		AND = {
			AND = {
				NOR = {
					has_modifier = resort_colony
					has_modifier = slave_colony
				}
				exists = owner
				owner = {
					has_origin = origin_cybernetic_creed
					NOR = {
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_war
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_labor
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_construction
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_general
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				exists = owner
				has_upgraded_capital = yes
				hidden_trigger = {
					owner = {
						has_origin = origin_cybernetic_creed
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					fail_text = not_cybernetic_creed_research
					owner = {
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_research
					}
				}
			}
		}
		num_buildings = {
			type = building_amphitheater_of_the_mind
			value < 1
		}
		owner = {
			OR = {
				check_variable_arithmetic = {
					which = value:rb_le_cap_empire_limit_building_amphitheater_of_the_mind
					value < 0
				}
				num_buildings = {
					type = building_amphitheater_of_the_mind
					value < value:rb_le_cap_empire_limit_building_amphitheater_of_the_mind
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			free_building_slots > 0
			rb_le_building_zones_for_building_amphitheater_of_the_mind = yes
		}
	}
}

								has_modifier = penal_colony
							}
							exists = owner
							owner = {
								is_wilderness_empire = no
							}
							OR = {
								has_carrier_flag = ignore_ai_building_limitations
								owner = {
									is_ai = no
								}
								has_any_research_society_zone = yes
								has_any_unspecialized_research_zone = yes
							}
						}
						num_buildings = {
							type = building_biolab_1
							value < 1
						}
						AND = {
							free_building_slots > 0
							rb_le_building_zones_for_building_archaeostudies_faculty = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	}

						OR = {
							has_active_building = building_commensal_clearing_1
							AND = {
								AND = {
									exists = owner
									owner = {
										is_wilderness_empire = yes
									}
								}
								AND = {
									free_building_slots > 0
									rb_le_building_zones_for_building_bureaucratic_1 = yes
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

}

rb_le_can_build_building_factory_3 = {
	AND = {
		owner = {
			has_technology = tech_luxuries_2
		}
		AND = {
			exists = owner
			owner = {
				country_uses_consumer_goods = yes
			}
			NOT = {
				has_modifier = resort_colony
				has_modifier = slave_colony
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_active_building = building_factory_2
			AND = {
				owner = {
					has_technology = tech_luxuries_1
				}
				AND = {
					exists = owner
					owner = {
						country_uses_consumer_goods = yes
					}
					NOT = {
						has_modifier = resort_colony
						has_modifier = slave_colony
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_active_building = building_factory_1
					AND = {
						owner = {
							has_technology = tech_basic_industry
						}
						AND = {
							exists = owner
							owner = {
								OR = {
									country_uses_consumer_goods = yes
									has_origin = origin_fear_of_the_dark
								}
							}
							NOR = {
								has_modifier = resort_colony
								has_modifier = slave_colony
							}
							OR = {
								has_carrier_flag = ignore_ai_building_limitations
								owner = {
									is_ai = no
								}
								owner = {
									has_valid_civic = civic_machine_obsessional_directive
								}
								AND = {
									has_any_factory_zone = yes
									NOR = {
										has_building = building_factory_1
										has_building = building_factory_2
										has_building = building_factory_3
									}
								}
								AND = {
									owner = {
										is_nomadic = yes
									}
									tiered_building_below_cap = {
										BUILDING = factory
									}
								}
							}
						}
						AND = {
							free_building_slots > 0
							rb_le_building_zones_for_building_affluence_emporium = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_fe_administration_1 = {
	AND = {
		AND = {
			AND = {
				owner? = {
					is_hive_empire = no
					is_machine_empire = no
					is_spiritualist = no
					has_make_spiritualist_perk = no
					OR = {
						is_fallen_empire = yes
						has_technology = tech_fe_administration_1
						has_country_flag = fe_administration_1_can_build
					}
				}
				NOR = {
					has_modifier = resort_colony
					has_modifier = slave_colony
					has_modifier = penal_colony
				}
			}
			AND = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					fail_text = ancrel.10004.failtext
					owner? = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = {
								which = fe_administration_1_build_count
								value >= 1
							}
							is_fallen_empire = yes
							has_technology = tech_fe_administration_1
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		num_buildings = {
			type = building_fe_administration_1
			value < 1
		}
		AND = {
			free_building_slots > 0
			rb_le_building_zones_for_building_bureaucratic_1 = yes
		}
	}
}

			AND = {
				owner? = {
					OR = {
						is_fallen_empire = yes
						has_technology = tech_fe_entertainment_2
						has_country_flag = fe_entertainment_1_can_build
					}
				}
				NOR = {
					has_modifier = slave_colony
					has_modifier = penal_colony
				}
			}
			AND = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					fail_text = ancrel.10004.failtext
					owner? = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = {
								which = fe_entertainment_1_upgrade_count
								value >= 1
							}
							is_fallen_empire = yes
							has_technology = tech_fe_entertainment_2
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		num_buildings = {
			type = building_fe_entertainment_2
			value < 1
		}
		OR = {
			has_active_building = building_fe_entertainment_1
			AND = {
				AND = {
					AND = {
						owner? = {
							is_hive_empire = no
							is_machine_empire = no
							OR = {
								is_fallen_empire = yes
								has_technology = tech_fe_entertainment_1
								has_country_flag = fe_entertainment_1_can_build
							}
						}
						NOR = {
							has_modifier = slave_colony
							has_modifier = penal_colony
						}
					}
					AND = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							fail_text = ancrel.10004.failtext
							owner? = {
								OR = {
									check_variable = {
										which = fe_entertainment_1_build_count
										value >= 1
									}
									is_fallen_empire = yes
									has_technology = tech_fe_entertainment_1
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				num_buildings = {
					type = building_fe_entertainment_1
					value < 1
				}
				AND = {
					free_building_slots > 0
					rb_le_building_zones_for_building_embassy = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_food_conglomerate = {
	AND = {
		has_branch_office = yes
		AND = {
			has_branch_office = yes
			branch_office_owner = {
				is_legit_or_legal_criminal = yes
			}
			NOR = {
				is_planet_class = pc_hive
				is_planet_class = pc_machine
				is_planet_class = pc_relic
			}
		}
		num_buildings = {
			owner_type = corporate
			type = building_food_conglomerate
			value < 1
		}
		free_branch_office_building_slots > 0
	}
}

					has_modifier = resort_colony
					has_modifier = slave_colony
				}
				exists = owner
				owner = {
					has_origin = origin_cybernetic_creed
					NOR = {
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_research
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_war
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_labor
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_general
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_upgraded_capital = yes
				hidden_trigger = {
					owner = {
						has_origin = origin_cybernetic_creed
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					fail_text = not_cybernetic_creed_construction
					owner = {
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_construction
					}
				}
			}
		}
		num_buildings = {
			type = building_forge_of_the_fellowship
			value < 1
		}
		owner = {
			OR = {
				check_variable_arithmetic = {
					which = value:rb_le_cap_empire_limit_building_forge_of_the_fellowship
					value < 0
				}
				num_buildings = {
					type = building_forge_of_the_fellowship
					value < value:rb_le_cap_empire_limit_building_forge_of_the_fellowship
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			free_building_slots > 0
			rb_le_building_zones_for_building_forge_of_the_fellowship = yes
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_fortress = {
	AND = {
		owner = {
			has_technology = tech_global_defense_grid
		}
		AND = {
			AND = {
				exists = owner
				owner = {
					is_wilderness_empire = no
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_upgraded_capital = yes
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_active_building = building_stronghold
			AND = {
				owner = {
					has_technology = tech_planetary_defenses
				}
				AND = {
					AND = {
						exists = owner
						NOT = {
							has_modifier = resort_colony
						}
						owner = {
							is_wilderness_empire = no
						}
					}
					AND = {
						exists = owner
						OR = {
							has_carrier_flag = ignore_ai_building_limitations
							owner = {
								is_ai = no
							}
							has_any_fortress_zone = yes
							AND = {
								num_buildings = {
									type = building_stronghold
									value < 2
								}
								num_buildings = {
									type = building_fortress
									value < 2
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				AND = {
					free_building_slots > 0
					rb_le_building_zones_for_building_dread_encampment = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			}

				exists = owner

				}

					has_carrier_flag = ignore_ai_building_limitations
					owner = {
						is_ai = no
					}

						has_any_industrial_zone = yes
						NOR = {
							has_building = building_foundry_1
							has_building = building_foundry_2
							has_building = building_foundry_3
						}
					}
					AND = {
						owner = {
							is_nomadic = yes

					}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {

			rb_le_building_zones_for_building_bio_furnace = yes
		}
	}

				}

				fail_text = not_cybernetic_creed_war
				owner = {
					has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_war
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_active_building = building_battlement_of_steel

						}
					}
				}
				num_buildings = {
					type = building_forge_of_the_fellowship
					value < 1
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						check_variable_arithmetic = {
							which = value:rb_le_cap_empire_limit_building_forge_of_the_fellowship
							value < 0
						}
						num_buildings = {
							type = building_forge_of_the_fellowship
							value < value:rb_le_cap_empire_limit_building_forge_of_the_fellowship
						}
					}
				}
				AND = {
					free_building_slots > 0
					rb_le_building_zones_for_building_forge_of_the_fellowship = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_hab_major_capital = {

		}

rb_le_can_build_building_hall_judgment = {
	AND = {
		owner = {
			has_technology = tech_colonial_centralization
		}
		AND = {
			owner = {
				is_regular_empire = yes
				NOT = {
					has_valid_civic = civic_civil_education
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				has_modifier = slave_colony
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						is_ai = yes
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					has_forbidden_jobs = enforcer
				}
				NOT = {
					has_available_jobs = enforcer
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_active_building = building_precinct_house
			AND = {
				owner = {
					has_technology = tech_planetary_government
				}
				AND = {
					AND = {
						owner = {
							is_regular_empire = yes
							NOT = {
								has_valid_civic = civic_civil_education
							}
						}
						NOT = {
							has_modifier = slave_colony
						}
					}
					AND = {
						hidden_trigger = {
							OR = {
								owner = {
									is_ai = no
								}
								AND = {
									NOT = {
										has_forbidden_jobs = enforcer
									}
									NOT = {
										has_available_jobs = enforcer
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				AND = {
					free_building_slots > 0
					rb_le_building_zones_for_building_embassy = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_heritage_site = {
	AND = {
		owner = {
			has_technology = tech_heritage_site
		}
		AND = {
			AND = {
				exists = owner
				NOR = {
					has_modifier = slave_colony
					has_modifier = penal_colony
				}
				owner = {
					is_gestalt = no
					is_megacorp = no
					can_have_default_memorial = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_upgraded_capital = yes
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_active_building = building_autochthon_monument
			AND = {
				owner = {
					has_technology = tech_cultural_heritage
				}
				AND = {
					exists = owner
					NOR = {
						has_modifier = slave_colony
						has_modifier = penal_colony
					}
					owner = {
						is_gestalt = no
						is_megacorp = no
						can_have_default_memorial = yes
					}
					owner = {
						is_ai = no
					}
				}
				num_buildings = {
					type = building_autochthon_monument
					value < 1
				}
				AND = {
					free_building_slots > 0
					rb_le_building_zones_for_building_bureaucratic_1 = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				}

					is_ai = no

			}
			NOT = {
				has_building = building_low_tech_capital
			}
		}
		AND = {

			rb_le_building_zones_for_building_holo_theatres = yes
		}
	}

							owner? = {
								is_machine_empire = no
								is_gestalt = no
								ideology? = {
									is_spiritualist = yes
								}
							}
						}
						num_buildings = {
							type = building_ideological_church
							value < 1
						}
						AND = {
							free_building_slots > 0
							rb_le_building_zones_for_building_nuumismatic_shrine = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_imperial_capital = {
	AND = {
		AND = {
			AND = {
				exists = owner
				owner = {
					is_regular_empire = yes
					is_galactic_emperor = yes
				}
				planet = {
					is_capital = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				sapient_pop_amount >= 5000
			}
		}
		OR = {
			OR = {
				has_active_building = building_hab_system_capital
				AND = {
					owner = {
						has_technology = tech_habitat_3
					}
					AND = {
						AND = {
							uses_habitat_capitals = yes
							exists = owner
							owner = {
								is_fallen_empire = no
								is_wilderness_empire = no
							}
						}
						AND = {
							sapient_pop_amount >= 2500
						}
					}
					OR = {
						has_active_building = building_hab_major_capital
						AND = {
							owner = {
								has_technology = tech_habitat_2
							}
							AND = {
								AND = {
									uses_habitat_capitals = yes
									exists = owner
									owner = {
										is_fallen_empire = no
										is_wilderness_empire = no
									}
								}
								AND = {
									sapient_pop_amount >= 1000
								}
							}
							has_active_building = building_hab_capital
						}
					}
				}
			}
			OR = {
				has_active_building = building_system_capital
				AND = {
					owner = {
						has_technology = tech_galactic_administration
					}
					AND = {
						AND = {
							exists = owner
							owner = {
								is_regular_empire = yes
								is_fallen_empire = no
							}
							NOR = {
								has_modifier = resort_colony
								has_modifier = slave_colony
							}
						}
						AND = {
							sapient_pop_amount >= 5000
						}
					}
					OR = {
						has_active_building = building_major_capital
						AND = {
							owner = {
								has_technology = tech_colonial_centralization
							}
							AND = {
								AND = {
									exists = owner
									owner = {
										is_regular_empire = yes
										is_fallen_empire = no
									}
									NOR = {
										has_modifier = resort_colony
										has_modifier = slave_colony
									}
								}
								AND = {
									sapient_pop_amount >= 2500
								}
							}
							OR = {
								has_active_building = building_capital
								AND = {
									owner = {
										has_technology = tech_planetary_government
									}
									AND = {
										AND = {
											exists = owner
											owner = {
												is_regular_empire = yes
												is_fallen_empire = no
											}
											NOR = {
												has_modifier = resort_colony
												has_modifier = slave_colony
												uses_habitat_capitals = yes
												is_planet_class = pc_cosmogenesis_world
											}
										}
										AND = {
											sapient_pop_amount >= 1000
										}
									}
									OR = {
										has_active_building = building_colony_shelter
										has_active_building = building_low_tech_capital
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_machine_assembly_complex = {
	AND = {
		owner = {
			has_technology = tech_mega_assembly
		}
		AND = {
			exists = owner
			owner = {
				OR = {
					is_machine_empire = yes
					is_individual_machine = yes
					is_hive_empire_with_machines = yes
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				has_modifier = resort_colony
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_active_building = building_machine_assembly_plant
			AND = {
				AND = {
					AND = {
						exists = owner
						owner = {
							OR = {
								is_machine_empire = yes
								is_individual_machine = yes
								is_hive_empire_with_machines = yes
							}
						}
						NOT = {
							has_modifier = resort_colony
						}
					}
					AND = {
						hidden_trigger = {
							OR = {
								owner = {
									is_ai = no
								}
								NAND = {
									free_district_slots = 0
									free_building_slots <= 1
									free_housing <= 0
									free_jobs <= 0
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				num_buildings = {
					type = building_machine_assembly_plant
					value < 1
				}
				AND = {
					free_building_slots > 0
					rb_le_building_zones_for_building_embassy = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						is_country_type = primitive
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_ai = no

					prev = {
						if = {
							limit = {
								has_branch_office = yes

						}
						NOT = {
							has_forbidden_jobs = entertainer
						}
						planet_stability < 50
						free_amenities < 0
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_active_building = building_medical_1
			AND = {
				owner = {
					has_technology = tech_basic_health
				}
				AND = {
					exists = owner

						has_modifier = penal_colony

			has_branch_office = yes
			branch_office_owner = {
				is_legit_or_legal_criminal = yes
			}
		}
		num_buildings = {
			owner_type = corporate
			type = building_military_contractors
			value < 1
		}
		free_branch_office_building_slots > 0
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_mineral_purification_hub = {
	AND = {
		owner = {
			has_technology = tech_mineral_purification_2
		}
		AND = {
			AND = {
				exists = owner
				owner = {
					is_wilderness_empire = no
				}
				OR = {
					owner = {
						is_ai = no
					}
					has_any_mining_district_or_building = yes
					owner = {
						is_nomadic = yes
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_upgraded_capital = yes
				NOT = {
					has_modifier = resort_colony
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_active_building = building_mineral_purification_plant
			AND = {
				owner = {
					has_technology = tech_mineral_purification_1
				}
				AND = {
					owner = {
						is_wilderness_empire = no
					}
					NOR = {
						has_modifier = resort_colony
						is_planet_class = pc_ringworld_habitable
						is_planet_class = pc_cybrex
					}
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							is_planet_class = pc_habitat
						}
						AND = {
							is_planet_class = pc_habitat
							check_modifier_value = {
								modifier = district_hab_mining_max_add
								value > 0
							}
						}
					}
					OR = {
						has_carrier_flag = ignore_ai_building_limitations
						owner = {
							is_ai = no
						}
						has_any_mining_district_or_building = yes
						owner = {
							is_nomadic = yes
						}
					}
				}
				num_buildings = {
					type = building_mineral_purification_plant
					value < 1
				}
				AND = {
					free_building_slots > 0
					rb_le_building_zones_for_building_mineral_purification_plant = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

rb_le_can_build_building_sanctuary_of_toil = {
	AND = {
		AND = {
			AND = {
				NOR = {
					has_modifier = resort_colony
					has_modifier = slave_colony
				}
				exists = owner
				owner = {
					has_origin = origin_cybernetic_creed
					NOR = {
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_research
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_war
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_construction
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_general
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_upgraded_capital = yes
				hidden_trigger = {
					exists = owner
					owner = {
						has_origin = origin_cybernetic_creed
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					fail_text = not_cybernetic_creed_labor
					owner = {
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_labor
					}
				}
			}
		}
		num_buildings = {
			type = building_sanctuary_of_toil
			value < 1
		}
		owner = {
			OR = {
				check_variable_arithmetic = {
					which = value:rb_le_cap_empire_limit_building_sanctuary_of_toil
					value < 0
				}
				num_buildings = {
					type = building_sanctuary_of_toil
					value < value:rb_le_cap_empire_limit_building_sanctuary_of_toil
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			free_building_slots > 0
			rb_le_building_zones_for_building_sanctuary_of_toil = yes
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_stronghold = {
	AND = {
		owner = {
			has_technology = tech_planetary_defenses
		}
		AND = {
			AND = {
				exists = owner
				NOT = {
					has_modifier = resort_colony
				}
				owner = {
					is_wilderness_empire = no
				}
			}
			AND = {
				exists = owner
				OR = {
					has_carrier_flag = ignore_ai_building_limitations
					owner = {
						is_ai = no
					}
					has_any_fortress_zone = yes
					AND = {
						num_buildings = {
							type = building_stronghold
							value < 2
						}
						num_buildings = {
							type = building_fortress
							value < 2
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			free_building_slots > 0
			rb_le_building_zones_for_building_dread_encampment = yes
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_system_capital = {
	AND = {
		owner = {
			has_technology = tech_galactic_administration
		}
		AND = {
			AND = {
				exists = owner
				owner = {
					is_regular_empire = yes
					is_fallen_empire = no
				}
				NOR = {
					has_modifier = resort_colony
					has_modifier = slave_colony
				}
			}
			AND = {
				sapient_pop_amount >= 5000
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_active_building = building_major_capital
			AND = {
				owner = {
					has_technology = tech_colonial_centralization
				}
				AND = {
					AND = {
						exists = owner
						owner = {
							is_regular_empire = yes
							is_fallen_empire = no
						}
						NOR = {
							has_modifier = resort_colony
							has_modifier = slave_colony
						}
					}
					AND = {
						sapient_pop_amount >= 2500
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_active_building = building_capital
					AND = {
						owner = {
							has_technology = tech_planetary_government
						}
						AND = {
							AND = {
								exists = owner
								owner = {
									is_regular_empire = yes
									is_fallen_empire = no
								}
								NOR = {
									has_modifier = resort_colony
									has_modifier = slave_colony
									uses_habitat_capitals = yes
									is_planet_class = pc_cosmogenesis_world
								}
							}
							AND = {
								sapient_pop_amount >= 1000
							}
						}
						OR = {
							has_active_building = building_colony_shelter
							has_active_building = building_low_tech_capital
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_system_capital_wilderness = {
	AND = {
		owner = {
			has_technology = tech_galactic_administration
		}
		AND = {
			AND = {
				exists = owner
				owner = {
					is_wilderness_empire = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_free_districts = {
					type = any
					value = 0
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_active_building = building_major_capital_wilderness
			AND = {
				owner = {
					has_technology = tech_colonial_centralization
				}
				AND = {
					AND = {
						exists = owner
						owner = {
							is_wilderness_empire = yes
						}
					}
					AND = {
						num_free_districts = {
							type = any
							value <= 5
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_active_building = building_capital_wilderness
					AND = {
						owner = {
							has_technology = tech_planetary_government
						}
						AND = {
							AND = {
								exists = owner
								owner = {
									is_wilderness_empire = yes
								}
							}
							AND = {
								num_free_districts = {
									type = any
									value <= 10
								}
							}
						}
						has_active_building = building_colony_shelter_wilderness
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_building_the_sanctum_of_augmentation = {
	AND = {
		AND = {
			AND = {
				NOR = {
					has_modifier = resort_colony
					has_modifier = slave_colony
				}
				exists = owner
				owner = {
					has_origin = origin_cybernetic_creed
					has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_general
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_upgraded_capital = yes
				hidden_trigger = {
					exists = owner
					owner = {
						has_origin = origin_cybernetic_creed
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					fail_text = not_cybernetic_creed_general
					owner = {
						has_country_flag = cybernetic_creed_general
					}
				}
			}
		}
		num_buildings = {
			type = building_the_sanctum_of_augmentation
			value < 1
		}
		owner = {
			OR = {
				check_variable_arithmetic = {
					which = value:rb_le_cap_empire_limit_building_the_sanctum_of_augmentation
					value < 0
				}
				num_buildings = {
					type = building_the_sanctum_of_augmentation
					value < value:rb_le_cap_empire_limit_building_the_sanctum_of_augmentation
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			free_building_slots > 0
			rb_le_building_zones_for_building_bureaucratic_1 = yes
		}
	}
}

				OR = {
					has_modifier = resort_colony

						has_deposit = d_alien_pets_deposit
						has_deposit = d_avian_reserve

								has_policy_flag = pre_sapients_protect
							}
							any_owned_pop_group = {
								is_sapient = no
							}
						}
						AND = {
							exists = owner
							any_owned_pop_group = {
								has_citizenship_type = {
									type = citizenship_protected_drone
									country = owner
								}
							}
						}
						any_owned_pop_group = {
							is_livestock = yes
						}
						AND = {
							exists = owner
							any_owned_pop_group = {
								has_trait = trait_nascent_stage
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		num_buildings = {
			type = building_xeno_zoo
			value < 1
		}
		AND = {
			free_building_slots > 0
			rb_le_building_zones_for_building_xeno_zoo = yes
		}
	}

rb_le_can_build_district_city = {
	AND = {
		AND = {
			AND = {
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						exists = owner
					}
					AND = {
						exists = owner
						owner = {
							OR = {
								is_regular_empire = yes
								AND = {
									is_country_type = primitive
									is_hive_empire = no
								}
								is_country_type = mechanocalibrator
							}
						}
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					has_deposit = d_crashed_slaver_ship
				}
				OR = {
					uses_district_set = district_resort
					uses_district_set = standard
					uses_district_set = hive_world
					uses_district_set = machine_world
					uses_district_set = shattered_ring_world
					uses_district_set = volcanic_world
				}
				is_special_colony_type = no
				NAND = {
					is_capital = yes
					owner = {
						has_menace_perk = menp_behemoth_mind_meld
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				hidden_trigger = {
					is_special_colony_type = no
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					fail_text = arcology_project_construction_fail_tt
					NOT = {
						has_carrier_flag = arcology_project_construction
					}
				}
			}
		}
		free_district_slots > 0
		num_free_districts = {
			type = district_city
			value > 0
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_district_crashed_slaver_ship = {
	AND = {
		AND = {
			AND = {
				uses_district_set = standard
				has_deposit = d_crashed_slaver_ship
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = owner
					}
					NAND = {
						is_capital = yes
						owner = {
							has_menace_perk = menp_behemoth_mind_meld
						}
					}
					owner = {
						is_wilderness_empire = no
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				hidden_trigger = {
					NAND = {
						has_modifier = resort_colony
						has_modifier = slave_colony
					}
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					fail_text = arcology_project_construction_fail_tt
					NOT = {
						has_carrier_flag = arcology_project_construction
					}
				}
			}
		}
		free_district_slots > 0
		num_free_districts = {
			type = district_crashed_slaver_ship
			value > 0
		}
	}
}

						has_carrier_flag = arcology_project_construction
					}
				}
			}
		}
		free_district_slots > 0
		num_free_districts = {
			type = district_slave
			value > 0
		}
	}
}

rb_le_can_build_hunting_grounds = {
	AND = {
		AND = {
			OR = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_trophy_hunter_job = yes
						has_hunter_drone_job = yes
					}
				}
				planet = {
					has_zone = {
						zone = zone_resort_hunting_ground
					}
				}
			}
		}
		num_buildings = {
			type = hunting_grounds
			value < 1
		}
		AND = {
			free_building_slots > 0
			rb_le_building_zones_for_hunting_grounds = yes
		}
	}
}

			AND = {

				owner = {
					has_technology = tech_xeno_relations
					is_regular_empire = yes
				}
				is_orbital_ring = yes
				planet = {
					is_capital = yes
					NOR = {
						has_modifier = resort_colony
						has_modifier = slave_colony
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				planet = {
					NOR = {
						has_building_construction = building_embassy
						has_building = building_embassy
						has_building_construction = building_grand_embassy
						has_building = building_grand_embassy
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	AND = {
		AND = {
			AND = {
				owner? = {
					has_valid_civic = civic_agrarian_idyll
					is_anglers_empire = yes
				}
				is_wet = yes
			}
			AND = {
				hidden_trigger = {
					owner? = {
						has_valid_civic = civic_agrarian_idyll
						is_anglers_empire = yes
					}
					is_wet = yes
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				AND = {
					AND = {
						owner? = {
							is_megacity_architects_empire = no
						}
					}
					AND = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							fail_text = zone_unavailable_tech_food_processing_1
							OR = {
								AND = {
									owner = {
										is_anglers_empire = yes
									}
									is_wet = yes
								}
								AND = {
									owner = {
										has_valid_civic = civic_agrarian_idyll
									}
								}
								AND = {
									owner = {
										has_tech_or_functional_civic = {
											TECH = tech_food_processing_1
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					OR = {
						has_district = district_farming
						rb_le_can_build_district_farming = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_orchard_forests
						rb_le_can_build_district_orchard_forests = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_farming
						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_farming = yes
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				AND = {
					AND = {
						owner? = {
							is_megacity_architects_empire = yes
						}
					}
					AND = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							fail_text = zone_unavailable_tech_food_processing_1
							OR = {
								AND = {
									owner = {
										is_anglers_empire = yes
									}
									is_wet = yes
								}
								AND = {
									owner = {
										has_tech_or_functional_civic = {
											TECH = tech_food_processing_1
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					OR = {
						has_district = district_farming
						rb_le_can_build_district_farming = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_farming

			}

						}

				}
			}
			AND = {
				hidden_trigger = {

						is_wilderness_empire = no
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {

	}

rb_le_can_build_zone_exotic_gases = {
	AND = {
		AND = {
			AND = {
				has_exotic_gases_deposit = yes
			}
			AND = {
				hidden_trigger = {
					has_exotic_gases_deposit = yes
				}
				owner? = {
					has_technology = tech_mine_exotic_gases
				}
			}
		}
		num_zones = {
			type = zone_exotic_gases
			value < 1
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				AND = {
					AND = {
						owner? = {
							is_megacity_architects_empire = no
						}
					}
					AND = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							fail_text = zone_unavailable_tech_food_processing_1

									}

								AND = {
									owner = {

											TECH = tech_food_processing_1
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					OR = {
						has_district = district_orchard_forests

					}

						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_hive = yes

			AND = {

					custom_tooltip = {

								}

							has_upgraded_capital = yes
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {

					OR = {

							is_megacity_architects_empire = yes
						}
					}
					AND = {

								has_tech_or_functional_civic = {

					rb_le_can_build_district_hab_housing = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {

							fail_text = zone_unavailable_tech_food_processing_1

						is_wilderness_empire = no
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {

					always = yes
				}

					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_hive
						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_hive = yes
					}

								}
							}
							always = yes
						}
						else = {
							has_upgraded_capital = yes
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {

					}
				}

			AND = {

						AND = {
							exists = owner

rb_le_can_build_zone_research_unity = {
	AND = {
		AND = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				owner? = {
					is_wilderness_empire = no
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				AND = {
					always = yes
				}
				OR = {
					has_district = district_ark_city
					rb_le_can_build_district_ark_city = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				AND = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						fail_text = d_collapsed_spire_blocks_zone
						NOT = {
							has_deposit = d_collapsed_spire
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					OR = {
						has_district = district_arcology_housing
						rb_le_can_build_district_arcology_housing = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_arcology_leisure
						rb_le_can_build_district_arcology_leisure = yes
					}
					OR = {

						rb_le_can_build_district_battle_thrall = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_city
						rb_le_can_build_district_city = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_craglands
						rb_le_can_build_district_craglands = yes
					}
					OR = {

						rb_le_can_build_district_hive = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_mindlink
						rb_le_can_build_district_mindlink = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_nexus
						rb_le_can_build_district_nexus = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_prison
						rb_le_can_build_district_prison = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_prison_industrial
						rb_le_can_build_district_prison_industrial = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_city
						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_city = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_hive
						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_hive = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_nexus
						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_nexus = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_science
						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_science = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_slave
						rb_le_can_build_district_slave = yes
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				AND = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						fail_text = zone_city_02_prereq
						if = {
							limit = {
								exists = owner
								owner = {
									is_primitive = yes
								}
							}
							always = yes
						}
						else = {
							has_upgraded_capital = yes
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					OR = {
						has_district = district_arcology_housing
						rb_le_can_build_district_arcology_housing = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_arcology_leisure
						rb_le_can_build_district_arcology_leisure = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_battle_thrall
						rb_le_can_build_district_battle_thrall = yes
					}
					OR = {

						rb_le_can_build_district_city = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_craglands
						rb_le_can_build_district_craglands = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_hive
						rb_le_can_build_district_hive = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_mindlink
						rb_le_can_build_district_mindlink = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_nexus
						rb_le_can_build_district_nexus = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_prison
						rb_le_can_build_district_prison = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_prison_industrial
						rb_le_can_build_district_prison_industrial = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_city
						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_city = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_hive
						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_hive = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_nexus
						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_nexus = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_slave
						rb_le_can_build_district_slave = yes
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				AND = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						fail_text = zone_city_03_prereq
						OR = {
							AND = {
								is_capital = yes
								exists = owner
								owner = {
									has_technology = tech_planetary_unification
								}
								has_upgraded_capital = yes
							}
							AND = {
								is_capital = no
								exists = owner
								owner = {
									has_tech_or_functional_civic = {
										TECH = tech_colonial_bureaucracy
									}
								}
								has_upgraded_capital = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_commercial
						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_commercial = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_srw_commercial
						rb_le_can_build_district_srw_commercial = yes
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				AND = {
					AND = {
						owner? = {
							is_megacity_architects_empire = yes
						}
					}
					AND = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							fail_text = zone_unavailable_tech_power_hub_1
							owner = {
								has_tech_or_functional_civic = {
									TECH = tech_power_hub_1
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					OR = {
						has_district = district_generator
						rb_le_can_build_district_generator = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_geothermal
						rb_le_can_build_district_geothermal = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_generator
						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_generator = yes
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				AND = {
					AND = {
						owner? = {
							is_megacity_architects_empire = yes
						}
					}
					AND = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							fail_text = zone_unavailable_tech_food_processing_1
							OR = {
								AND = {
									owner = {
										is_anglers_empire = yes
									}
									is_wet = yes
								}
								AND = {
									owner = {
										has_tech_or_functional_civic = {
											TECH = tech_food_processing_1
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					OR = {
						has_district = district_farming
						rb_le_can_build_district_farming = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_rw_farming
						rb_le_can_build_district_rw_farming = yes
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				AND = {
					AND = {
						owner? = {
							is_megacity_architects_empire = yes
						}
					}
					AND = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							fail_text = zone_unavailable_tech_mineral_purification_1
							owner = {
								has_tech_or_functional_civic = {
									TECH = tech_mineral_purification_1
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					OR = {
						has_district = district_melting
						rb_le_can_build_district_melting = yes
					}
					OR = {
						has_district = district_mining
						rb_le_can_build_district_mining = yes
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				AND = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						fail_text = zone_unavailable_tech_planetary_unification
						exists = owner
						owner = {
							has_tech_or_functional_civic = {

				}

					always = yes
